title: #smallpoems #coronaschooling Yellow and orange buses snake our hallways generator's hum keeping time My back creaking laptop my only heat crouched on
summary: #smallpoems #coronaschooling Yellow and orange buses snake our hallways generator's hum keeping time My back creaking laptop my only heat crouched on floor cramped in son's room Eight Note March assessing his clarinet playing on our shared hot spot the wifi, not the computer in my lap
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
#coronaschooling
Yellow and orange buses
snake our hallways
generator's hum
keeping
time
My back creaking
laptop my only
heat
crouched on floor
cramped in son's
room
Eight Note March
assessing
his clarinet playing
on our shared hot spot
the wifi,
not the
computer in
my lap
